hooks.text: China's last emperor ended up as a quiet Beijing gardener.
In 1912, a six-year-old boy lost a two-millennium empire.
The living god of the Forbidden City held a watering can.

title: Why the Last Emperor of China Became a Gardener 🌸
description: Discover how Puyi, the final emperor of China, went from a worshipped ruler to a quiet Beijing gardener.
